def process(loadWaterTesting) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    import re

    df = loadWaterTesting.copy()

    # Helper: standardize column names for easier matching
    norm = {c: re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c.strip().lower()) for c in df.columns}
    inv = {}
    for k, v in norm.items():
        inv.setdefault(v, []).append(k)

    def pick(possibles):
        for p in possibles:
            if p in inv:
                return inv[p][0]
        return None

    # Find key columns
    yearCol = pick(["year"]) \
        or pick(["sample year"]) \
        or pick(["collection year"]) \
        or pick(["date", "sample date", "collection date"])  # will parse year

    waterTypeCol = pick(["water type", "waterbody type", "water body type", "beach type", "site type"]) \
        or pick(["waterbody", "water body", "waterbody category"]) \
        or pick(["beach"])  # fallback

    exceedCol = pick(["bacterial exceedance", "exceedance", "exceed", "exceeds", "exceedance flag", "exceedance?"]) \
        or pick(["result", "assessment", "status"]) \
        or pick(["geomean exceedance", "single sample exceedance"]) \
        or pick(["e. coli exceedance", "ecoli exceedance"]) \
        or pick(["failing", "pass/fail", "pass fail", "meets standard"]) \
        or pick(["beach action", "advisory"]) \
        or pick(["beach closure"]) 

    if yearCol is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find a year/date column. Available columns: {list(df.columns)}")
    if waterTypeCol is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find water-type column for identifying freshwater beaches. Available columns: {list(df.columns)}")
    if exceedCol is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not find exceedance/flag column. Available columns: {list(df.columns)}")

    # Extract year
    y = pd.to_numeric(df[yearCol], errors='coerce')
    if y.isna().mean() > 0.5:
        # likely a date
        y = pd.to_datetime(df[yearCol], errors='coerce').dt.year
    df["_year"] = y

    # Filter to freshwater beaches (case-insensitive contains)
    wt = df[waterTypeCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    isFresh = wt.str.contains("fresh", na=False)
    isBeach = wt.str.contains("beach", na=False)
    freshBeaches = df[isFresh & isBeach].copy()

    # Map exceedance to boolean 1/0
    raw = freshBeaches[exceedCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

    trueVals = {"1", "true", "t", "yes", "y", "exceed", "exceeded", "exceeds", "fail", "f", "positive", "action", "advisory", "closure"}
    falseVals = {"0", "false", "f", "no", "n", "non-exceed", "nonexceed", "not exceed", "pass", "p", "negative", "none"}

    def to01(s):
        if s in trueVals:
            return 1
        if s in falseVals:
            return 0
        # common patterns
        if "exceed" in s or "fail" in s or "action" in s or "advis" in s or "clos" in s:
            return 1
        if "pass" in s or "meet" in s:
            return 0
        return np.nan

    freshBeaches["_exceed"] = raw.map(to01)

    # Keep only 2002-2023 inclusive
    freshBeaches = freshBeaches[(freshBeaches["_year"] >= 2002) & (freshBeaches["_year"] <= 2023)].copy()

    # Compute per-year exceedance rate
    grp = freshBeaches.groupby("_year", dropna=True)["_exceed"].agg([
        ("nSamples", "count"),
        ("nExceed", "sum"),
        ("rate", "mean"),
    ]).reset_index().rename(columns={"_year": "year"})

    # Overall average freshwater beach exceedance rate across all samples
    overall = freshBeaches["_exceed"].mean()

    grp["overallAvgRate"] = overall

    # years with rate higher than overall average, using rates rounded to 2 decimals per prompt
    grp["rate2"] = grp["rate"].round(2)
    grp["overall2"] = round(float(overall), 2) if pd.notna(overall) else np.nan
    grp["aboveAvg"] = grp["rate2"] > grp["overall2"]

    out = grp.sort_values("year")
    return out

def process(loadWaterTesting) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = loadWaterTesting.copy()

    # Explicit columns based on observed schema
    yearCol = "Year"
    waterTypeCol = "Beach Type Description"  # values: Fresh / Marine
    exceedCol = "Violation"  # values like yes/no with case variants

    # Extract year
    df["_year"] = pd.to_numeric(df[yearCol], errors="coerce")

    # Freshwater beaches: Beach Type Description == 'Fresh'
    wt = df[waterTypeCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    freshBeaches = df[wt.eq("fresh")].copy()

    # Exceedance flag
    raw = freshBeaches[exceedCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

    trueVals = {"yes", "y", "true", "1"}
    falseVals = {"no", "n", "false", "0", "nan", ""}

    def to01(s: str):
        if s in trueVals:
            return 1
        if s in falseVals:
            return 0
        # fallback patterns
        if "yes" in s or "exceed" in s or "viol" in s or "fail" in s:
            return 1
        if "no" in s or "pass" in s or "meet" in s:
            return 0
        return np.nan

    freshBeaches["_exceed"] = raw.map(to01)

    # Keep only 2002-2023 inclusive
    freshBeaches = freshBeaches[(freshBeaches["_year"] >= 2002) & (freshBeaches["_year"] <= 2023)].copy()

    # Per-year exceedance rate (mean over non-null exceed flags)
    grp = (
        freshBeaches.groupby("_year", dropna=True)["_exceed"].agg(
            nSamples="count",
            nExceed="sum",
            rate="mean",
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={"_year": "year"})
        .sort_values("year")
    )

    # Overall average freshwater beach exceedance rate across all samples
    overall = freshBeaches["_exceed"].mean()

    grp["overallAvgRate"] = overall

    # Compare using 2-decimal rounded rates per prompt
    grp["rate2"] = grp["rate"].round(2)
    grp["overall2"] = round(float(overall), 2) if pd.notna(overall) else np.nan
    grp["aboveAvg"] = grp["rate2"] > grp["overall2"]

    return grp

      def process(loadWaterTesting) -> pd.DataFrame:
          import pandas as pd
          import numpy as np
      
          df = loadWaterTesting.copy()
      
          # Explicit columns based on observed schema
          yearCol = "Year"
          waterTypeCol = "Beach Type Description"  # values: Fresh / Marine
          exceedCol = "Violation"  # values like yes/no with case variants
      
          # Extract year
          df["_year"] = pd.to_numeric(df[yearCol], errors="coerce")
      
          # Freshwater beaches: Beach Type Description == 'Fresh'
          wt = df[waterTypeCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
          freshBeaches = df[wt.eq("fresh")].copy()
      
          # Exceedance flag
          raw = freshBeaches[exceedCol].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
      
          trueVals = {"yes", "y", "true", "1"}
          falseVals = {"no", "n", "false", "0", "nan", ""}
      
          def to01(s: str):
              if s in trueVals:
                  return 1
              if s in falseVals:
                  return 0
              # fallback patterns
              if "yes" in s or "exceed" in s or "viol" in s or "fail" in s:
                  return 1
              if "no" in s or "pass" in s or "meet" in s:
                  return 0
              return np.nan
      
          freshBeaches["_exceed"] = raw.map(to01)
      
          # Keep only 2002-2023 inclusive
          freshBeaches = freshBeaches[(freshBeaches["_year"] >= 2002) & (freshBeaches["_year"] <= 2023)].copy()
      
          # Per-year exceedance rate (mean over non-null exceed flags)
          grp = (
              freshBeaches.groupby("_year", dropna=True)["_exceed"].agg(
                  nSamples="count",
                  nExceed="sum",
                  rate="mean",
              )
              .reset_index()
              .rename(columns={"_year": "year"})
              .sort_values("year")
          )
      
          # Overall average freshwater beach exceedance rate across all samples
          overall = freshBeaches["_exceed"].mean()
      
          grp["overallAvgRate"] = overall
      
          # Compare using 2-decimal rounded rates per prompt
          grp["rate2"] = grp["rate"].round(2)
          grp["overall2"] = round(float(overall), 2) if pd.notna(overall) else np.nan
          grp["aboveAvg"] = grp["rate2"] > grp["overall2"]
      
          return grp
